components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sharp technical product action aligned with shadcn/ui primary tokens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sharp 36px field with transparent fill, structural border, and strong focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Nearly square bordered panel; sharp, technical, and flat by default.
components.html:
Runtime report

Inspect audio state, route output, and render health.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 20px/28px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Oscilloscope Trace
components.description: P31 green shader-derived trace treatment reserved for oscilloscope surfaces.
components.css: .ds-scope { border: 1px solid color(srgb 0.03 0.78 0.2 / 0.22); border-radius: 0; background: #020604; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color(srgb 0.004 0.08 0.018 / 0.8); padding: 16px; } .ds-scope svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-scope path { fill: none; stroke: color(srgb 0.03 0.78 0.2); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: square; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px color(srgb 0.74 1 0.71 / 0.45)); }

narrative.overview: KKB is a sharp technical creative monorepo. Its design system preserves shadcn/ui semantic tokens, TX-02-forward technical typography, low-radius machined surfaces, scoped audio blues, and shader-derived oscilloscope greens.
keyCharacteristics: shadcn/ui-compatible semantic tokens remain the canonical frontmatter vocabulary.
TX-02 carries headings, labels, code, telemetry, and compact hardware-style UI.
Geist carries readable prose and body copy.
Cool audio blues are scoped to audio and waveform surfaces.
P31 phosphor greens are scoped to oscilloscope traces, glow, and shader-derived visualizations.
Edges are sharp by default; roundness must be earned.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Use shadcn/ui token names in docs and components. Descriptive names are prose, not replacements for semantic token names.

rules.name: The Blue-and-Green Scope Rule
rules.body: Audio blue belongs to audio and waveform UI. P31 green belongs to oscilloscope traces and shader-derived visualizations.

rules.name: The TX-02 Heading Rule
rules.body: KKB's technical voice uses TX-02 for headings and labels.

rules.name: The Flat Product Rule
rules.body: A resting product surface should not look lifted.

dos: Do preserve shadcn/ui token names in frontmatter and generated docs.
Do keep roundness low: 1-4px for most controls and panels, 6px only for larger containers, full radius only for badges/avatars/sliders/switches.
Do use audio blue for audio and waveform state, and P31 green for oscilloscope trace/glow state.
donts: Don't replace semantic shadcn/ui tokens with descriptive aliases in frontmatter.
Don't use the audio blue accent as a general-purpose brand color.
Don't use oscilloscope green as a generic success color.
Don't use rounded soft cards, pillowy inputs, glassmorphism, heavy gradients, or generic glossy SaaS styling.
